CustomField.formula: IF( OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(RLM_Territory__c)), ISBLANK(RLM_Owner_Territory__c)), "Territory not set", IF( NOT(RLM_Regional_Exception__c), "In region", IF( ISPICKVAL(RLM_Regional_Approval_Status__c, "Approved"), "Out of region - approved", IF( ISPICKVAL(RLM_Regional_Approval_Status__c, "Pending"), "Out of region - awaiting approval", IF( ISPICKVAL(RLM_Regional_Approval_Status__c, "Rejected"), "Out of region - rejected", "Out of region - approval required" ) ) ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Whether the deal is cleared to move past Qualification.
CustomField.label: Regional Status
